metadata.description: Third of the three Elf-fathers who awoke at Cuiviénen. His name is Quenya for 'Three, Third'. Together with Imin and Tata, he awakened other sleeping Elves. His spouse was Enelyë. They found 72 companions total, becoming the Nelyar – the largest clan. His fold became the Sindar, Teleri, and Lindar. Ancestor of Elwë (Thingol) and Olwë.
